title: Address of a composed literal query
statement: Let $n>0$, let $V$ be a Boolean proof-checking system with input length $n$, proof length $m$, and $r$ query positions, and let $K$ be a positive integer. Given a seedwise three-CNF reduction for $V$ with $K$ clauses, a verifier seed, a clause index among the $K$ clauses, and one of three query positions determine the composed address of the corresponding literal’s variable, in the disjoint union of the $n$ input positions and the $m+K|S|$ composed-proof positions, where $S$ is the verifier’s finite seed set.
hypotheses_covered: $V$ is a Boolean PCPP system with input length $n$, proof length $m$, and $r$ query positions
a seedwise three-CNF reduction for $V$ with parameter $K$
